source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Identifying a Problem Clearly (printed page 21, read from a second copy of the book; not in this scan).

blocks.text: Masle ko saaf saaf pehchanna (identify karna) masla hal karne ka pehla aur sab se aham qadam hai. Hamein samajhna chahiye ke masla hum se kya pooch raha hai. Yeh jaanna zaroori hai ke kya maloomat (given information) di gayi hai aur kya nateeja (expected result) chahiye. Aasan sawal poochne se masla behtar samajh aata hai. Ghair zaroori tafseel (unnecessary details) ko nazar andaz karna chahiye. Saaf samjha hua masla sahi hal tak le jata hai. Yeh qadam waqt aur mehnat bachata hai. Saaf soch masla hal karna aasan bana deti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kisi bhi masle ko shuru karne se pehle teen sawal poochein: (1) Mujh se kya poocha gaya hai? (2) Mere paas kya diya gaya hai (given)? (3) Aakhir mein kya nateeja chahiye (expected result)? Jo baat in sawalon se ta'alluq nahi rakhti, use chhor dein.

blocks.prompt: Sawal: 'Ali ki class mein 40 students hain, class ka kamra neela hai. Har student ki fees 500 rupay hai. Kul fees kitni hogi?' Is masle mein given, expected result aur ghair zaroori baat batayein.
blocks.explanation: Given: 40 students, har aik ki fees 500 rupay. Expected result: kul fees (40 x 500 = 20000 rupay). Ghair zaroori: kamre ka rang neela hona; is se jawab par koi asar nahi.

items: Masle ko saaf pehchanna pehla aur sab se aham qadam hai.
Jaanein: masla kya poochta hai, kya diya gaya hai, kya nateeja chahiye.
Aasan sawal poochein, ghair zaroori tafseel chhor dein; is se waqt aur mehnat bachti hai.
